source.instruction: После выпуска переноса полностью доработать страницу изменения веса: общую таблицу, попапы, алерты и все состояния по принятому канону; работать автономно, без вопросов, тщательно проверить до публикации.
source.supersedes: docs/ui/decisions-20261024-feo-weight-popups.json: limitation preserving the old seven-column history registry and popup wording overridden by this later complete-page instruction
source.review_gate: Independent ROOT visual review of populated/empty registry, editor, validation, history, final confirmation and responsive states before publication.

scope: /erpv2/company/feo/requests/weights — registry, create, editor, read-only history, final confirmation, notifications
inherits: docs/ui/decisions-20261024-feo-weight-popups.json: weight business behavior, NULL/0 and shared editor roles
docs/ui/decisions-20261025-feo-transfer-v007.json: later approved history title, table spacing, reading and confirmation roles, count removal and footer behavior
docs/ui/decisions-20261023-toolbar.json: shared toolbar order and reset behavior

visible_role_provenance.page_head: Existing registry_ui_head.php and approved primary button; retained weight page heading, summary and Tabler arrows-exchange icon from 2026-10-24 approved weight page.
visible_role_provenance.toolbar: Shared registry-ui-toolbar, found-label, filter-sep, registry-ui-checkbox, registry-ui-reset, toolbar-select and registry-ui-search. The returned-block visibility meaning and unchecked default, net/gross selection and reset order follow the approved transfer registry. Weight-specific text is the existing weight business vocabulary.
visible_role_provenance.main_table: Shared registry-ui-table--placement/--placement-blocks row, header, ID, primary and missing roles. The seven columns are ID, Заявки, Заявок, Было, Стало, Дата, Ответственный; ID/full request IDs/date/author are already approved on transfer history, and Было/Стало plus independent net/gross weights come from the approved weight editor. The select names the displayed weight kind. ID keyboard activation and row double-click follow the approved transfer history. Returned rows use the existing registry-ui-muted state and remain hidden by default.
visible_role_provenance.create: Existing approved weight create flow, 96px shared field-textarea, automatic lookup, five-column shared compact editor table, red field errors, blank=NULL and 0 kg as a real value. The later transfer v007 removes the nonessential count above the table; duplicate summary is shown only when duplicates exist. No new local component.
visible_role_provenance.history: Shared registry-ui-modal--reading, #ID title, page-eyebrow label, complete request list and compact bordered five-column weight table. Existing weight business values remain read-only. The later transfer v007 removes the count above the table. Footer retains the weight action name Отменить изменение веса and shared primary button for applied blocks; returned blocks have only Отменить.
visible_role_provenance.confirmation: Shared registry-ui-modal--confirmation at 640px, one plain sentence with every bold request ID and shared red btn-danger Выполнить возврат, plus Отменить. The later transfer v007 removed the extra conflict warning from visible text; server conflict protection remains.
visible_role_provenance.notifications: Shared PlanexNotifications only for brief page outcomes and fetch errors; semantic success/warning/danger tones and five-second dismissal from 2026-10-26 notification center. Field errors stay adjacent to their field, using existing field-msg is-error; blocking database failure stays in page.
visible_role_provenance.responsive: Approved registry/table horizontal scroll and shared modal internal 300px table scroll, no page-level horizontal overflow. Subject CSS defines only seven weight-column widths, with no new font, color, border, surface or control skin.

data_contract: Read-only batched index joins feo_weight_items for full ID lists and historic before/after totals. Net/gross are summed independently in kg; any missing value makes that total unknown (neutral dash), while known zero is 0 кг. No production schema/data writes or change to create/revert transaction.
